g.text: how often is the lens cleaned
Pick a file to hear it.
The lens is cleaned every morning at dawn, before the light is shut off. Soot
from the lamp builds up overnight and dims the beam by a third within a week.
Brass fittings are polished on Saturdays. The fog signal is tested on the first of
Visibility at noon: 14 nautical miles. Wind north-east, force 4.
